policy: Symbolic provenance-only table of named provisional parameters. NO numeric values are recorded here (ED-0019; reviewer amendment 1): parameter magnitudes are NOT ratified and must never appear as fixture expectations or bound literals. Fixtures reference parameters by NAME only.

parameters.name: coordBoundMm
parameters.meaning: Maximum |x|,|y| for every authoritative plan coordinate

parameters.name: dimensionCapMm
parameters.meaning: Inclusive upper cap for strictly-positive dimension fields and non-negative sillMm

parameters.name: derivedCoordBoundMm
parameters.meaning: Upper bound for ideal derived vertices; breach is an implementation defect, never user-input rejection

parameters.name: lwwHorizon
parameters.meaning: Retained competing-write horizon for snapshot winner POSITIONS, creation positions and tombstones (FS 5.1 S1/S3/S4 as widened by ED-0037)
parameters.candidateValueSource: not a chosen quantity: the horizon is DERIVED from the snapshot's own S2 coverage
parameters.ratifiedBy: ED-0105 (complete coverage; no count, age or byte window)

ratifiedQuantitiesNote: Ratified v0.1 quantities live solely in FORMAT-SPEC §9.3 and are cited there by row ID (L1–L33); this table intentionally does not duplicate them.
